signup.title: Create your account
signup.intro: We'll send a one-time code to verify you. After that, you can set a password.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.intro: Enter your account email and we'll send you a link to set a new password. It works even if you've never set one.
forgot.sentFallback: If this email has a Miles Masterclass account, we've emailed you a link to set your password.
forgot.spam: Don't see it? Check your spam folder. The link works once, for 30 minutes.

reset.title: Get your new password
reset.intro: This link gives your account a new password, shown only once. Reveal it when you're ready to copy it.
reset.note: Revealing it signs your account out on every device.
reset.missing: This link is incomplete. Request a new one.
reset.doneIntro: Copy it now: it won't be shown again. Use it with your email to log in.
reset.doneNote: This password replaces any earlier one, and you've been signed out on every device.
